display_name: Treatment Plan Checklist Version 1 - 42 Step PRD

acronyms.definition: Electronic Medical Record, such as Alleva or another approved chart system.
Application Programming Interface for approved system-to-system chart access.
Protected Health Information that must remain under approved privacy and security controls.
Medical Record Number or equivalent safe chart identifier.
Level of Care, such as PHP, IOP, IOP-5, IOP-19, IOP-3, OP, or Outpatient.
Large Language Model; optional and disabled by default.
American Society of Addiction Medicine criteria when used by the facility workflow.

review_statuses.label: Not Reviewed
review_statuses.description: The checklist item is known but review has not started.

review_statuses.label: Ready for Review
review_statuses.description: Enough source material is present for reviewer work.

review_statuses.label: In Review
review_statuses.description: A reviewer or deterministic rule pass is evaluating the item.

review_statuses.label: Needs Human Review
review_statuses.description: The app found evidence that requires human review before disposition.

review_statuses.label: Passed
review_statuses.description: The reviewed item satisfied the configured checklist evidence.

review_statuses.label: Failed
review_statuses.description: The reviewed item has confirmed checklist failures.

review_statuses.label: Missing Required Data
review_statuses.description: Required metadata or source evidence is absent.

review_statuses.label: Error
review_statuses.description: A technical or parsing error prevented review completion.

review_statuses.label: Finalized
review_statuses.description: The reviewer completed final disposition for this item.

review_statuses.label: Current / Compliant
review_statuses.description: The item is supported by required evidence and validated timing rules.

review_statuses.label: Due Soon
review_statuses.description: The item is approaching the configured due date.

review_statuses.label: Urgent
review_statuses.description: The item is inside the urgent follow-up window.

review_statuses.label: Overdue
review_statuses.description: The validated due date has passed.

review_statuses.label: Needs Review
review_statuses.description: Evidence is missing, conflicting, ambiguous, or policy-dependent.

review_statuses.label: Missing Data
review_statuses.description: Required source evidence is absent or unreadable.

review_statuses.label: Conflicting Evidence
review_statuses.description: Source dates, LOC, identity, signatures, or status disagree.

review_statuses.label: Unable to Evaluate
review_statuses.description: The app cannot produce a deterministic result from available evidence.

review_statuses.label: Returned for Correction
review_statuses.description: A manager returned the chart with specific correction comments.

review_statuses.label: Approved / Finalized
review_statuses.description: A manager approved the chart after issues were resolved or accepted.

loc_change_blocker.message: The treatment-plan update window after a level-of-care change is not confirmed. Keep this setting configurable and mark LOC-change results as Needs Review until R3 confirms exact days, calendar/business basis, and clock-start date.

steps.title: Confirm this is the correct client chart
steps.objective: Verify documents belong to the intended client and no conflicting client IDs appear across source documents.
checks: Compare patient ID or MRN across every source.
Flag conflicting identifiers.
Do not use real PHI in test/demo evidence.
finding_examples: Two source documents reference different patient IDs.
Client identifier is missing from an uploaded export.
remediation_suggestions: Correct the source set, split mixed-client documents, or return the chart for clarification.

steps.title: Identify whether the review is for a new chart or an existing chart update
steps.objective: Classify the case as a new baseline review or an update against existing chart history.
checks: Record whether the review is initial or update.
Compare update uploads against active prior binders when available.
finding_examples: Existing chart uploaded as an initial review.
Update cannot find a prior active binder.
remediation_suggestions: Switch upload mode, link the prior chart, or document why this is a new baseline.

steps.title: Confirm the client is active
steps.objective: Evaluate active clients by default and exclude discharged or inactive clients from routine Treatment Plan Tracking.
checks: Treat blank discharge date or active status as in scope.
Exclude inactive/discharged clients unless explicitly filtered.
finding_examples: Discharge date exists but client remains in active queue.
Active status is missing.
remediation_suggestions: Update client status evidence or remove the chart from active tracking.

steps.title: Confirm the admission date
steps.objective: Capture the admission date because it anchors Initial and Master Treatment Plan timing.
checks: Parse admission date.
Flag missing or conflicting admission dates.
finding_examples: Admission date is blank.
Admission date differs between overview and treatment plan.
remediation_suggestions: Correct admission metadata or return the chart with a request for source evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the current LOC
steps.objective: Capture current level of care because LOC determines treatment-plan review cadence.
checks: Find the latest active LOC row.
Treat latest row without discharge date as current when available.
finding_examples: Current LOC is blank.
Multiple LOC rows appear current.
remediation_suggestions: Correct LOC metadata or document which source is authoritative.

steps.title: Confirm the LOC maps to a Version 1 rule category
steps.objective: Map LOC aliases to configured PHP, IOP, IOP-5, IOP-19, IOP-3, OP, or Outpatient rule categories.
checks: Use configurable LOC aliases.
Return Unable to Evaluate or Needs Review for unknown LOC.
finding_examples: LOC value cannot be mapped.
Alias exists in notes but not in rules config.
remediation_suggestions: Add a confirmed LOC alias to rules config or manually review the chart.

steps.title: Capture LOC history when available
steps.objective: Preserve prior and current LOC evidence so LOC-change cases can be identified.
checks: Store LOC, facility, effective date, discharge date, and source evidence.
Flag missing effective dates.
finding_examples: LOC history is unavailable.
LOC history has a current row without an effective date.
remediation_suggestions: Upload/source the LOC history panel or add reviewer notes explaining the gap.

steps.title: Classify each source document
steps.objective: Label each document as Initial Treatment Plan, Master Treatment Plan, Treatment Plan Review, LOC Change Update, supporting note, or other relevant type.
checks: Classify treatment-plan evidence separately from generic clinical notes.
Keep source IDs for traceability.
finding_examples: Treatment Plan Review is misclassified as a generic note.
Source document ID is absent.
remediation_suggestions: Correct document metadata or re-upload with document labels.

steps.title: Confirm each document date
steps.objective: Capture reliable document dates because checklist timing depends on them.
checks: Parse document dates.
Flag future, missing, or conflicting dates.
finding_examples: Document date is missing.
Document date is after signature date.
remediation_suggestions: Correct metadata or document why a source date is authoritative.

steps.title: Confirm each document's completion status
steps.objective: Mark documents completed, incomplete, missing, not applicable, or needing review.
checks: Do not count draft or incomplete documents as valid without reviewer confirmation.
Preserve completion source evidence.
finding_examples: Master plan is marked draft.
Review document completion status is missing.
remediation_suggestions: Return for completion or record an authorized manual acceptance reason.

steps.title: Confirm staff/therapist signature status
steps.objective: Track required staff or therapist signature presence and dates.
checks: Require staff signature for valid Initial, Master, and Review evidence.
Flag missing staff signature dates.
finding_examples: Review exists but staff signature is missing.
Signature date is unreadable.
remediation_suggestions: Return for staff signature or add authorized manual confirmation with evidence.

steps.title: Confirm client signature status
steps.objective: Track required client signature evidence for Initial and Master plans; ongoing reviews may be optional for MVP.
checks: Require client signature for Initial and Master plans.
Do not fail ongoing reviews solely for missing client signature.
finding_examples: Initial plan lacks client signature.
Review client signature is blank but staff signature exists.
remediation_suggestions: Return Initial/Master signature gaps; annotate optional review signature cases.

steps.title: Check for conflicting evidence
steps.objective: Flag conflicts in dates, LOC, completion status, signatures, identity, or source evidence.
checks: Compare calculated and source due dates.
Compare identities and signature dates across sources.
finding_examples: Displayed next due date conflicts with calculated due date.
LOC differs between documents.
remediation_suggestions: Require manual review and document which source is authoritative.

steps.title: Check that the Initial Treatment Plan exists
steps.objective: Confirm an Initial Treatment Plan source document exists for the chart.
checks: Find a classified Initial Treatment Plan.
Flag missing initial plan evidence.
finding_examples: No Initial Treatment Plan found.
remediation_suggestions: Upload or import the Initial Treatment Plan before approval.

steps.title: Check that the Initial Treatment Plan is dated correctly
steps.objective: Tie Initial Treatment Plan date to admission date unless R3 confirms a different rule.
checks: Compare initial plan date to admission date.
Flag mismatches as Needs Review.
finding_examples: Initial plan date is after admission date.
Admission date is missing.
remediation_suggestions: Correct dates or document accepted timing exception.

steps.title: Check that the Initial Treatment Plan has required signatures
steps.objective: Do not count Initial Treatment Plan evidence as valid unless required signature evidence is present.
checks: Require staff and client signature dates.
Compare signatures to admission date.
finding_examples: Initial plan staff signature is missing.
Initial plan client signature date conflicts with admission.
remediation_suggestions: Return for signature correction or record authorized manual acceptance.

steps.title: Check that the Master Treatment Plan exists
steps.objective: Confirm a Master Treatment Plan source document exists for the chart.
checks: Find a classified Master Treatment Plan.
Flag missing master plan evidence.
finding_examples: No Master Treatment Plan found.
remediation_suggestions: Upload or import the Master Treatment Plan before approval.

steps.title: Check that the Master Treatment Plan was completed within 30 calendar days of admission
steps.objective: Use admission date plus 30 calendar days unless R3 confirms another standard.
checks: Calculate admission + 30 calendar days.
Require completion/signature evidence inside the window.
finding_examples: Master plan signed after the 30-day window.
Master plan due date cannot be calculated.
remediation_suggestions: Return late/missing plans or document accepted manual review.

steps.title: Check that the Master Treatment Plan has required signatures
steps.objective: Do not count Master Treatment Plan evidence as valid unless staff and client signatures are present.
checks: Require staff and client signature dates.
Flag signatures outside the 30-day window.
finding_examples: Master plan client signature is missing.
Master plan staff signature is late.
remediation_suggestions: Return for signature correction or record authorized manual acceptance.

steps.title: Identify the latest valid Treatment Plan Review
steps.objective: Find the most recent completed and signed review used to calculate the next due date.
checks: Require completed review evidence with staff signature.
Exclude conflicting or invalid review rows.
finding_examples: Review exists but no staff signature date is present.
Only invalid review rows were found.
remediation_suggestions: Upload/import signed review evidence or manually confirm the valid source.

steps.title: Calculate the next Treatment Plan Review due date
steps.objective: Calculate from latest valid review date using configured LOC interval while showing source due-date cross-checks.
checks: Calculate signature anchor due date.
Show document Next Review Due and LOC effective anchor when present.
finding_examples: Calculated due date differs from displayed Next Review Due.
Interval cannot be found for LOC.
remediation_suggestions: Review the evidence comparison and document the accepted anchor.

steps.title: Apply the PHP timing rule
steps.objective: Apply a 30-day treatment-plan review interval for PHP.
checks: Map PHP aliases.
Calculate latest valid review plus 30 calendar days.
finding_examples: PHP review due date is overdue.
PHP alias is not configured.
remediation_suggestions: Confirm PHP mapping or return the overdue review for correction.

steps.title: Apply the IOP/OP timing rule
steps.objective: Apply a 60-day treatment-plan review interval for IOP, IOP-5, IOP-19, IOP-3, OP, and Outpatient.
checks: Map configured IOP/OP aliases.
Calculate latest valid review plus 60 calendar days.
finding_examples: IOP-5 review date conflicts with LOC anchor.
Outpatient alias is unknown.
remediation_suggestions: Confirm LOC alias mapping and due-date anchor.

steps.title: Mark the treatment plan as current when inside the allowed window
steps.objective: Mark Current/Compliant only when latest valid review remains inside the required validated timeframe.
checks: Current status requires validated timing and evidence.
Do not mark current when data is missing or conflicting.
finding_examples: Current status shown while LOC-change conflict remains unresolved.
remediation_suggestions: Use Needs Review until the conflict is resolved or accepted with reason.

steps.title: Mark the treatment plan as due soon when approaching the deadline
steps.objective: Surface approaching due dates before they become overdue.
checks: Use configured warning windows.
Show plain-English next action.
finding_examples: Due-soon item is not visible in queue.
remediation_suggestions: Review and schedule follow-up before the due date.

steps.title: Mark the treatment plan as overdue when past the deadline
steps.objective: Flag overdue or noncompliant status after the validated due date has passed.
checks: Overdue status is higher priority than due soon/current.
Show evidence behind overdue calculation.
finding_examples: Past-due treatment plan still appears current.
remediation_suggestions: Return for correction or record manager acceptance with reason.

steps.title: Check PHP individual-session evidence when available
steps.objective: Confirm PHP individual-session evidence when notes contain that evidence.
checks: Apply only when PHP evidence exists.
Flag insufficient or conflicting session evidence.
finding_examples: PHP session count appears below expected threshold.
No session evidence is available to evaluate.
remediation_suggestions: Upload supporting notes or mark unavailable evidence as Needs Review.

steps.title: Check IOP/OP individual-session evidence when available
steps.objective: Confirm IOP/OP individual-session evidence when notes contain that evidence.
checks: Apply only when IOP/OP evidence exists.
Flag insufficient or conflicting session evidence.
finding_examples: IOP individual-session evidence is missing.
Source evidence conflicts with session count.
remediation_suggestions: Upload supporting notes or mark unavailable evidence as Needs Review.

steps.title: Identify whether an LOC change occurred
steps.objective: Flag LOC-change treatment-plan update checks when LOC history shows a change.
checks: Detect multiple LOC rows.
Identify latest LOC effective date and previous discharge date.
finding_examples: LOC changed from PHP to IOP-5.
LOC change date is missing.
remediation_suggestions: Review LOC history and confirm the trigger date.

steps.title: Check for an LOC Change Update document when applicable
steps.objective: Look for update or review evidence tied to the LOC change.
checks: Search for LOC update/review documents.
Tie document to LOC effective date when possible.
finding_examples: LOC changed but no related update document exists.
LOC update exists but cannot be tied to the stepdown date.
remediation_suggestions: Upload/import LOC-change update evidence or document the gap.

steps.title: Hold the LOC-change deadline as unresolved until R3 confirms it
steps.objective: Do not hard-code the LOC-change window until R3 confirms days, calendar/business basis, and clock start.
checks: Show LOC-change rule as unvalidated.
Keep conflict status as Needs Review until validated.
finding_examples: LOC-change case was marked compliant using an unvalidated window.
remediation_suggestions: Keep Needs Review and ask R3/Marleigh for rule confirmation.

steps.title: Flag missing data instead of assuming compliance
steps.objective: Missing date, signature, LOC, plan, or review evidence must not pass silently.
checks: Emit Missing Data when required evidence is absent.
Never infer compliance from silence.
finding_examples: No staff signature exists but result is current.
Unknown LOC was treated as compliant.
remediation_suggestions: Collect source evidence or manually accept with reason.

steps.title: Allow manual reviewer confirmation
steps.objective: Reviewer can confirm, correct, override, or mark an item as needing manual confirmation.
checks: Restrict review actions to authorized roles.
Capture manual decision and comments.
finding_examples: Manual confirmation has no reviewer.
Unauthorized user attempted to override.
remediation_suggestions: Use manager/admin review controls and preserve audit details.

steps.title: Require a reason for manual overrides
steps.objective: Manual correction or override requires a clear audit reason.
checks: Block blank override reasons.
Store the reason in audit history without PHI or secrets.
finding_examples: Override submitted with no reason.
Override reason includes sensitive note text.
remediation_suggestions: Enter a concise synthetic/safe reason before saving.

steps.title: Produce a final checklist result for the chart
steps.objective: Show compliant, overdue, due soon, missing, conflicting, unable to evaluate, or needs-review outcome.
checks: Prioritize overdue, urgent, due soon, returned, needs review, missing data, conflicts, unable, current, approved.
Include evidence summary.
finding_examples: Overall result is blank.
Status priority hides an overdue result.
remediation_suggestions: Re-run deterministic evaluation and review blocking findings.

steps.title: Update the status worklist after review
steps.objective: Show done, needs review, overdue, due soon, missing data, returned for correction, or approved worklist status.
checks: Refresh worklist after review actions.
Keep statuses visible with text labels, not color alone.
finding_examples: Override saved but worklist still shows old status.
Returned item is missing from queue.
remediation_suggestions: Refresh queue or inspect audit history for failed status update.

steps.title: Route the chart for manager review
steps.objective: Checklist should be ready for manager review, approval, or return.
checks: Allow manager/admin review routing.
Keep counselor permissions separate from approval.
finding_examples: Counselor approved final result.
Manager route has no checklist result.
remediation_suggestions: Submit the chart to manager review after evidence review is complete.

steps.title: Return charts with specific correction comments
steps.objective: Returned comments identify what is missing, incorrect, late, or unclear.
checks: Block returns without specific comments.
Preserve comments in audit history.
finding_examples: Return submitted with a blank comment.
Comment is too vague to correct the chart.
remediation_suggestions: Enter specific correction language before returning.

steps.title: Approve charts only after checklist issues are resolved or accepted
steps.objective: Approval means Version 1 items passed or were manually reviewed and accepted.
checks: Block approval when unresolved required issues remain unless accepted with reason.
Record manager approval audit event.
finding_examples: Chart approved with missing required evidence and no acceptance reason.
remediation_suggestions: Resolve, return, or document manager acceptance for every blocking item.

steps.title: Preserve the review history
steps.objective: Store source evidence, checklist result, confirmations, overrides, approvals, returns, and timestamps.
checks: Audit review creation, findings, override, export, approval, and return.
Do not log PHI-like note text or secrets.
finding_examples: Override exists without an audit event.
Audit detail contains sensitive note text.
remediation_suggestions: Re-run action or inspect forensic logs for missing audit trail.

steps.title: Continue periodic monitoring when API access is available
steps.objective: Continue scheduled checking for new notes, changed statuses, overdue items, or newly due reviews.
checks: Use daily monitoring when API access is approved and configured.
Use mock/simulation monitoring while live import is blocked.
finding_examples: Daily refresh did not run.
API error is hidden from dashboard.
remediation_suggestions: Run a safe connectivity test, use manual monthly workflow, or document the API blocker.

steps.title: Use synthetic or approved non-PHI data for validation until production handling is approved
steps.objective: No real client-identifying data appears in tests, screenshots, docs, prompts, exports, or shared examples without approval.
checks: Use synthetic patient IDs in tests.
Do not commit raw video frames, real notes, secrets, or PHI.
finding_examples: Validation screenshot contains real chart data.
Export includes a bearer token.
remediation_suggestions: Remove unsafe artifact, replace with synthetic data, and document validation boundaries.
